replies.author: Unlikely_Perspective
replies.body:
Cool, I am interested in the automation. I see you have references to many animations and styles, also a ref that seems to pick what should be developed next in queue.

Would you mind describing how this works and what your loop is?

replies.author: agent_pppp67
replies.body:
first install gauntlet loop from this [https://github.com/robonuggets/gauntlet-loop](https://github.com/robonuggets/gauntlet-loop)  
just tell AI to install package for u.  then /gauntlet-loop Build a playable Cyberpunk: Edgerunners boss fight. You play David Martinez, fists only, with Devil May Cry style combos: chains, launchers, air juggles and dash cancels. Sandevistan slows the world while David stays fast. Every Sandevistan move and every dash leaves a trail of cyan-green afterimages.

give it some ref image and some fist combat video (i just crop some clip from crimson desert fist fighting and ZZZ gameplay) and then u let the gauntlet loop give u more precise prompt and then u let it start.   
  
let it run overnight and u get pretty much every thing.   the next morning i wake up and fix a bit of things like model quality, after image behavior and rework some feature that i don't like (finisher, overclock and so on) and then it is done as u see in the vid.   
  
for this demo I use Oriverse engine that we are developing for dedicated engine for ai workflow.  
I tried it with unreal 5.8 but ai kinda does slow jop with blueprint make it harder for ai.
